        const objLines = doc.splitTextToSize(lesson.objective, contentWidth);
        doc.text(objLines, margin, currentY);
        currentY += (objLines.length * 4.5) + 8;
      }

      // 2. Core Principles
      if (lesson.principles) {
        doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
        doc.setFontSize(9);
        doc.setTextColor(0, 0, 0);
        doc.text("CORE PRINCIPLES", margin, currentY);
        currentY += 5;
        doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
        doc.setTextColor(subTextColor[0], subTextColor[1], subTextColor[2]);
        lesson.principles.forEach(p => {
           doc.text(`• ${p}`, margin + 5, currentY);
           currentY += 5;
        });
        currentY += 3;
      }

      // 3. Action Breakdown
      if (lesson.actionSteps) {
        doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
        doc.setFontSize(9);
        doc.setTextColor(0, 0, 0);
        doc.text("ACTION BREAKDOWN", margin, currentY);
        currentY += 5;
        doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
        doc.setTextColor(subTextColor[0], subTextColor[1], subTextColor[2]);
        lesson.actionSteps.forEach((s, i) => {
           doc.text(`${i + 1}. ${s}`, margin + 5, currentY);
           currentY += 5;
        });
      }

      // End of Module Protocol Summary
      currentY = 265;
      doc.setFont("helvetica", "italic");
      doc.setFontSize(7);
      doc.setTextColor(neonColor[0], neonColor[1], neonColor[2]);
      doc.setFillColor(0, 0, 0);
      doc.rect(margin, currentY, contentWidth, 8, 'F');
      doc.text("END OF MODULE PROTOCOL: FREEDOM THROUGH STRUCTURE. PROTOCOL VALIDATED.", margin + 5, currentY + 5);

      doc.setTextColor(180, 180, 180);
      doc.text(`@BODYMATRIX.AI • SYNCED VIA SAYEMATRIX • MODULE: ${lesson.id.toUpperCase()}`, margin, 278);

Full lesson content first

const FreeLessons: React.FC<FreeLessonsProps> = ({ onBack, onSelectLesson }) => {
  const [isGenerating, setIsGenerating] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [sharingLesson, setSharingLesson] = useState<LessonCard | null>(null);
  const [doneId, setDoneId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const neonCyan = [0, 229, 255]; // #00E5FF
  const darkColor = [11, 15, 12]; // #0B0F0C

  const generateLessonPDFPage = (doc: any, lesson: LessonCard, index?: number) => {
    const margin = 20;
    const contentWidth = 170;
    let currentY = 20;

    // Header
    doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
    doc.setFontSize(8);
    doc.setTextColor(150, 150, 150);
    doc.text(`MODULE ID: ${lesson.id.toUpperCase()}`, margin, currentY);
    doc.text(`TAG: ${lesson.tag}`, 190, currentY, { align: 'right' });
    currentY += 10;

    // Title
    doc.setFontSize(22);
    doc.setTextColor(neonCyan[0], neonCyan[1], neonCyan[2]);
    const titleLines = doc.splitTextToSize(lesson.title.toUpperCase(), contentWidth);
    doc.text(titleLines, margin, currentY);
    currentY += (titleLines.length * 10) + 10;

    // Full Content
    doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
    doc.setFontSize(10);
    doc.setTextColor(60, 60, 60);
    const contentLines = doc.splitTextToSize(lesson.content, contentWidth);
    doc.text(contentLines, margin, currentY, { align: 'justify', lineHeightFactor: 1.4 });
    currentY += (contentLines.length * 5) + 15;

    // Breakdown Sections (Boxed)
    const drawBox = (title: string, items: string | string[]) => {
      const boxPadding = 8;
      doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
      doc.setFontSize(9);
      doc.setTextColor(neonCyan[0], neonCyan[1], neonCyan[2]);
      doc.text(title.toUpperCase(), margin + 2, currentY + 5);
      currentY += 8;

      doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
      doc.setFontSize(9);
      doc.setTextColor(80, 80, 80);
      
      const lines = Array.isArray(items) 
        ? items.flatMap(item => doc.splitTextToSize(`• ${item}`, contentWidth - 10))
        : doc.splitTextToSize(items, contentWidth - 10);
      
      const boxHeight = (lines.length * 5) + 6;
      
      doc.setDrawColor(neonCyan[0], neonCyan[1], neonCyan[2]);
      doc.setLineWidth(0.2);

                <div className="absolute top-6 left-6 bg-black/80 border border-neon/30 px-3 py-1 text-[10px] text-neon font-orbitron uppercase tracking-widest">{lesson.tag}</div>

                    <Share2 size={18} />
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/20 flex items-center justify-center opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
                  <div className="bg-neon rounded-full p-4 text-black shadow-neon"><Play fill="currentColor" size={24} /></div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="p-8 flex flex-col flex-grow">
                <h3 className="font-orbitron text-lg font-bold text-white mb-4 leading-tight group-hover:text-neon transition-colors uppercase">{lesson.title}</h3>
                <p className="font-space text-gray-500 mb-8 leading-relaxed line-clamp-2 text-sm">{lesson.description}</p>
                <div className="mt-auto flex justify-between items-center"><span className="font-orbitron text-[9px] text-neon/40 tracking-[0.2em] uppercase">Module Ready</span>
                  <button className="text-neon border border-neon/30 px-6 py-2 rounded-full font-orbitron text-[10px] hover:bg-neon hover:text-black transition-all">DECODE PROTOCOL</button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
      {sharingLesson && <ShareModal isOpen={!!sharingLesson} onClose={() => setSharingLesson(null)} title={sharingLesson.title} url={window.location.origin + "/#lesson/" + sharingLesson.id} />}
    </section>
  );
};

export default FreeLessons;

const FreeLessons: React.FC<FreeLessonsProps> = ({ onBack, onSelectLesson }) => {
  const [isGenerating, setIsGenerating] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [sharingLesson, setSharingLesson] = useState<LessonCard | null>(null);
  const [doneId, setDoneId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const neonCyan = [0, 229, 255]; // #00E5FF
  const darkColor = [11, 15, 12]; // #0B0F0C
  const margin = 20;
  const contentWidth = 170;
  const pageHeightLimit = 270; // mm (leaving space for footer)

  const drawHeaderFooter = (doc: any, lesson: LessonCard) => {
    const pageHeight = doc.internal.pageSize.height;
    
    // Header
    doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
    doc.setFontSize(8);
    doc.setTextColor(150, 150, 150);
    doc.text(`MODULE ID: ${lesson.id.toUpperCase()}`, margin, 15);
    doc.text(`TAG: ${lesson.tag}`, 190, 15, { align: 'right' });
    
    // Footer
    doc.setFont("helvetica", "italic");
    doc.setFontSize(7);
    doc.setTextColor(180, 180, 180);
    doc.text(`BODYMATRIX.AI - PROTOCOL EXTRACTION • PAGE ${doc.internal.getNumberOfPages()}`, margin, pageHeight - 10);
  };

  const generateLessonPDF = async (doc: any, lesson: LessonCard, startWithCover: boolean = false) => {
    let currentY = 25;

    if (startWithCover) {
      // TITLE PAGE
      doc.setFillColor(darkColor[0], darkColor[1], darkColor[2]);
      doc.rect(0, 0, 210, 297, 'F');
      
      doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
      doc.setFontSize(48);
      doc.setTextColor(neonCyan[0], neonCyan[1], neonCyan[2]);
      doc.text("BODYMATRIX.AI", 20, 100);
      
      doc.setFontSize(14);
      doc.setTextColor(255, 255, 255);
      doc.text("COMPLETE CURRICULUM CATALOG", 20, 115);
      
      doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
      doc.setFontSize(9);
      doc.setTextColor(150, 150, 150);
      doc.text("SAYEMATRIX FREE LEARNING ECOSYSTEM • 25 PROTOCOLS", 20, 125);
      
      doc.setDrawColor(neonCyan[0], neonCyan[1], neonCyan[2]);
      doc.setLineWidth(2);
      doc.line(20, 132, 100, 132);
      
      doc.addPage();
    }

    drawHeaderFooter(doc, lesson);

    // Title
    doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
    doc.setFontSize(22);
    doc.setTextColor(neonCyan[0], neonCyan[1], neonCyan[2]);
    const titleLines = doc.splitTextToSize(lesson.title.toUpperCase(), contentWidth);
    doc.text(titleLines, margin, currentY);
    currentY += (titleLines.length * 10) + 10;

    // Full Content with Pagination
    doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
    doc.setFontSize(10);
    doc.setTextColor(60, 60, 60);
    const contentLines = doc.splitTextToSize(lesson.content, contentWidth);
    
    contentLines.forEach((line: string) => {
      if (currentY > pageHeightLimit) {
        doc.addPage();
        drawHeaderFooter(doc, lesson);
        currentY = 25;
        doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
        doc.setFontSize(10);
        doc.setTextColor(60, 60, 60);
      }
      doc.text(line, margin, currentY);
      currentY += 6;
    });

    currentY += 10;

    // Boxed Sections with pagination checks
    const drawBoxedSection = (title: string, items: string | string[]) => {
      doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
      doc.setFontSize(9);
      doc.setTextColor(neonCyan[0], neonCyan[1], neonCyan[2]);
      
      const lines = Array.isArray(items) 
        ? items.flatMap(item => doc.splitTextToSize(`• ${item}`, contentWidth - 10))
        : doc.splitTextToSize(items, contentWidth - 10);
      
      const boxHeight = (lines.length * 5) + 12;

      // Check if box fits on current page
      if (currentY + boxHeight > pageHeightLimit) {
        doc.addPage();
        drawHeaderFooter(doc, lesson);
        currentY = 25;
        doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
        doc.setFontSize(9);
        doc.setTextColor(neonCyan[0], neonCyan[1], neonCyan[2]);
      }

      doc.text(title.toUpperCase(), margin + 2, currentY + 5);
      currentY += 8;

      doc.setDrawColor(neonCyan[0], neonCyan[1], neonCyan[2]);
      doc.setLineWidth(0.2);
      doc.rect(margin, currentY, contentWidth, (lines.length * 5) + 4);

      doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
      doc.setFontSize(9);
      doc.setTextColor(80, 80, 80);
      
      lines.forEach((line: string, i: number) => {
        doc.text(line, margin + 5, currentY + 5 + (i * 5));
      });
      
      currentY += (lines.length * 5) + 12;
    };

    if (lesson.objective) drawBoxedSection("Learning Objective", lesson.objective);
    if (lesson.principles) drawBoxedSection("Core Principles", lesson.principles);
    if (lesson.actionSteps) drawBoxedSection("Action Breakdown", lesson.actionSteps);
  };

  const downloadAllPDF = async () => {
    setIsGenerating('all');
    try {
      const { jsPDF } = await import('https://esm.sh/jspdf');
      const doc = new jsPDF();
      
      // We pass idx to handle first lesson cover differently if needed
      for (let i = 0; i < allLessons.length; i++) {
        await generateLessonPDF(doc, allLessons[i], i === 0);
        if (i < allLessons.length - 1) {
          doc.addPage();
        }
      }

      doc.save('BodyMatrix-Lessons-Catalog.pdf');
      setDoneId('all');
      setTimeout(() => setDoneId(null), 3000);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Catalog PDF Generation Error:", err);
    } finally {
      setIsGenerating(null);
    }
  };

  const downloadLessonPDF = async (lesson: LessonCard, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setIsGenerating(lesson.id);
    try {
      const { jsPDF } = await import('https://esm.sh/jspdf');
      const doc = new jsPDF();
      
      await generateLessonPDF(doc, lesson);
      
      doc.save(`BodyMatrix-${lesson.id}-Protocol.pdf`);
      setDoneId(lesson.id);
      setTimeout(() => setDoneId(null), 3000);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Individual PDF Error:", err);
    } finally {
      setIsGenerating(null);
    }
  };

  const handleShare = (e: React.MouseEvent, lesson: LessonCard) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setSharingLesson(lesson);
  };

  return (
    <section className="pt-40 pb-32 min-h-screen">
      <div className="container mx-auto px-6">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-6 mb-12">
          <button onClick={onBack} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-neon hover:text-white transition-colors font-orbitron text-xs uppercase tracking-widest">
            <ArrowLeft size={16} /> Back to Hub
          </button>
          
          <button 
            onClick={downloadAllPDF} 
            disabled={!!isGenerating} 
            className="flex items-center gap-3 bg-neon/10 border border-neon/30 text-neon px-8 py-4 rounded-2xl font-orbitron text-[10px] tracking-widest hover:bg-neon hover:text-black transition-all disabled:opacity-50 shadow-neon group"
          >
            {isGenerating === 'all' ? <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" /> : doneId === 'all' ? <Check size={16} /> : <Download size={16} />} 
            DOWNLOAD ALL 25 PROTOCOLS (PDF)
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="mb-20">
          <span className="text-neon font-space uppercase tracking-[0.4em] text-xs font-bold mb-4 block">Engineered Intelligence</span>
          <h1 className="font-orbitron text-4xl md:text-6xl font-bold text-white mb-6 uppercase leading-tight text-glow">KNOWLEDGE REPOSITORY</h1>
          <p className="font-space text-gray-400 max-w-2xl text-lg leading-relaxed">
            The complete 25-protocol curriculum for physical sovereignty. High-performance logic, decoded and ready for implementation.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="grid md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8">
          {allLessons.map((lesson) => (
            <div key={lesson.id} onClick={() => onSelectLesson(lesson)} className="group relative bg-dark-lighter border border-white/5 hover:border-neon transition-all duration-500 rounded-3xl overflow-hidden shadow-lg cursor-pointer flex flex-col h-full">
              <div className="h-60 overflow-hidden relative shrink-0">
                <img src={lesson.image} alt={lesson.title} className="w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-700 group-hover:scale-110 opacity-60 group-hover:opacity-100" />
                <div className="absolute top-6 left-6 bg-black/80 border border-neon/30 px-3 py-1 text-[10px] text-neon font-orbitron uppercase tracking-widest">{lesson.tag}</div>
                
                <div className="absolute top-6 right-6 flex gap-2">
                  <button 
                    onClick={(e) => downloadLessonPDF(lesson, e)}
                    className="p-3 bg-black/60 border border-white/10 text-white rounded-full hover:bg-neon hover:text-black hover:border-neon transition-all z-20 flex items-center justify-center"
                    title="Download Protocol PDF"
                  >
                    {isGenerating === lesson.id ? <Loader2 size={18} className="animate-spin" /> : doneId === lesson.id ? <Check size={18} /> : <FileText size={18} />}
                  </button>
                  <button onClick={(e) => handleShare(e, lesson)} className="p-3 bg-black/60 border border-white/10 text-white rounded-full hover:bg-neon hover:text-black hover:border-neon transition-all z-20" title="Share Topic">
                    <Share2 size={18} />
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/20 flex items-center justify-center opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
                  <div className="bg-neon rounded-full p-4 text-black shadow-neon"><Play fill="currentColor" size={24} /></div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="p-8 flex flex-col flex-grow">
                <h3 className="font-orbitron text-lg font-bold text-white mb-4 leading-tight group-hover:text-neon transition-colors uppercase">{lesson.title}</h3>
                <p className="font-space text-gray-400 mb-8 leading-relaxed line-clamp-2 text-sm">{lesson.description}</p>
                <div className="mt-auto flex justify-between items-center"><span className="font-orbitron text-[9px] text-neon/40 tracking-[0.2em] uppercase">Module Ready</span>
                  <button className="text-neon border border-neon/30 px-6 py-2 rounded-full font-orbitron text-[10px] hover:bg-neon hover:text-black transition-all">DECODE PROTOCOL</button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
      {sharingLesson && <ShareModal isOpen={!!sharingLesson} onClose={() => setSharingLesson(null)} title={sharingLesson.title} url={window.location.origin + "/#lesson/" + sharingLesson.id} />}
    </section>
  );
};

export default FreeLessons;

interface FreeLessonsProps {

const FreeLessons: React.FC<FreeLessonsProps> = ({ onBack, onSelectLesson }) => {
  const [isGenerating, setIsGenerating] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [sharingLesson, setSharingLesson] = useState<LessonCard | null>(null);
  const [doneId, setDoneId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // BodyMatrix Brand Colors
  const neonLime = [163, 255, 18]; // #A3FF12
  const darkBg = [11, 15, 12];     // #0B0F0C
  const darkLighter = [18, 24, 20]; // #121814
  
  const margin = 20;
  const contentWidth = 170;
  const pageHeightLimit = 265;

  const applyBrandStyles = (doc: any, lesson: LessonCard) => {
    // Page background
    doc.setFillColor(darkBg[0], darkBg[1], darkBg[2]);
    doc.rect(0, 0, 210, 297, 'F');

    // Header Glow
    doc.setFillColor(neonLime[0], neonLime[1], neonLime[2], 0.05);
    doc.rect(0, 0, 210, 40, 'F');
    
    // Header Info
    doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
    doc.setFontSize(7);
    doc.setTextColor(neonLime[0], neonLime[1], neonLime[2]);
    doc.text(`BODYMATRIX.AI // PROTOCOL ID: ${lesson.id.toUpperCase()}`, margin, 15);
    doc.text(`SYNC STATUS: VALIDATED`, 190, 15, { align: 'right' });

    // Footer Info
    const pageHeight = doc.internal.pageSize.height;
    doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
    doc.setFontSize(6);
    doc.setTextColor(80, 80, 80);
    doc.text(`@BODYMATRIX.AI • PART OF SAYEMATRIX ECOSYSTEM • PAGE ${doc.internal.getNumberOfPages()}`, margin, pageHeight - 12);
    doc.text(`"FREEDOM THROUGH STRUCTURE"`, 190, pageHeight - 12, { align: 'right' });
  };

  const generateLessonPDF = async (doc: any, lesson: LessonCard, startWithCover: boolean = false) => {
    let currentY = 35;

    if (startWithCover) {
      // BRAND COVER PAGE
      doc.setFillColor(darkBg[0], darkBg[1], darkBg[2]);
      doc.rect(0, 0, 210, 297, 'F');
      
      // Decorative elements
      doc.setDrawColor(neonLime[0], neonLime[1], neonLime[2]);
      doc.setLineWidth(0.5);
      doc.line(20, 130, 80, 130);

      doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
      doc.setFontSize(44);
      doc.setTextColor(neonLime[0], neonLime[1], neonLime[2]);
      doc.text("BODYMATRIX.AI", 20, 100);
      
      doc.setFontSize(16);
      doc.setTextColor(255, 255, 255);
      doc.text("KNOWLEDGEBASE CATALOG", 20, 115);
      
      doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
      doc.setFontSize(10);
      doc.setTextColor(150, 150, 150);
      doc.text("25 HIGH-PERFORMANCE MOVEMENT PROTOCOLS", 20, 125);
      doc.text("ENGINEERED FOR BIOLOGICAL SOVEREIGNTY", 20, 140);
      
      doc.setFontSize(8);
      doc.setTextColor(80, 80, 80);
      doc.text("SAYEMATRIX FREE LEARNING SYSTEM // VERSION 3.0", 20, 275);
      
      doc.addPage();
    }

    applyBrandStyles(doc, lesson);

    // Protocol Category Tag
    doc.setFillColor(neonLime[0], neonLime[1], neonLime[2]);
    doc.rect(margin, currentY, 25, 6, 'F');
    doc.setFontSize(7);
    doc.setTextColor(0, 0, 0);
    doc.text(lesson.tag.toUpperCase(), margin + 2, currentY + 4.5);
    currentY += 15;

    // Lesson Title
    doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
    doc.setFontSize(26);
    doc.setTextColor(255, 255, 255);
    const titleLines = doc.splitTextToSize(lesson.title.toUpperCase(), contentWidth);
    doc.text(titleLines, margin, currentY);
    currentY += (titleLines.length * 11) + 12;

    // Full Content Body
    doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
    doc.setFontSize(11);
    doc.setTextColor(200, 200, 200);
    const contentLines = doc.splitTextToSize(lesson.content, contentWidth);
    
    contentLines.forEach((line: string) => {
      if (currentY > pageHeightLimit) {
        doc.addPage();
        applyBrandStyles(doc, lesson);
        currentY = 35;
        doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
        doc.setFontSize(11);
        doc.setTextColor(200, 200, 200);
      }
      doc.text(line, margin, currentY, { align: 'justify', lineHeightFactor: 1.5 });
      currentY += 6.5;
    });

    currentY += 15;

    // Break Line
    doc.setDrawColor(30, 30, 30);
    doc.setLineWidth(0.5);
    doc.line(margin, currentY, margin + contentWidth, currentY);
    currentY += 12;

    // Boxed Technical Sections
    const drawTechnicalBox = (title: string, items: string | string[]) => {
      doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
      doc.setFontSize(10);
      doc.setTextColor(neonLime[0], neonLime[1], neonLime[2]);
      
      const lines = Array.isArray(items) 
        ? items.flatMap(item => doc.splitTextToSize(`• ${item}`, contentWidth - 14))
        : doc.splitTextToSize(items, contentWidth - 14);
      
      const boxHeight = (lines.length * 6) + 16;

      if (currentY + boxHeight > pageHeightLimit) {
        doc.addPage();
        applyBrandStyles(doc, lesson);
        currentY = 35;
        doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
        doc.setFontSize(10);
        doc.setTextColor(neonLime[0], neonLime[1], neonLime[2]);
      }

      // Box Background
      doc.setFillColor(darkLighter[0], darkLighter[1], darkLighter[2]);
      doc.setDrawColor(neonLime[0], neonLime[1], neonLime[2], 0.3);
      doc.rect(margin, currentY, contentWidth, boxHeight, 'FD');

      // Title
      doc.text(title.toUpperCase(), margin + 7, currentY + 8);
      
      // Text
      doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
      doc.setFontSize(10);
      doc.setTextColor(240, 240, 240);
      lines.forEach((line: string, i: number) => {
        doc.text(line, margin + 7, currentY + 16 + (i * 6));
      });
      
      currentY += boxHeight + 10;
    };

    if (lesson.objective) drawTechnicalBox("Operational Objective", lesson.objective);
    if (lesson.principles) drawTechnicalBox("Core Biomechanical Principles", lesson.principles);
    if (lesson.actionSteps) drawTechnicalBox("Systemic Action Breakdown", lesson.actionSteps);
  };

  const downloadAllPDF = async () => {
    setIsGenerating('all');
    try {
      const { jsPDF } = await import('https://esm.sh/jspdf');
      const doc = new jsPDF();
      
      for (let i = 0; i < allLessons.length; i++) {
        await generateLessonPDF(doc, allLessons[i], i === 0);
        if (i < allLessons.length - 1) {
          doc.addPage();
        }
      }

      doc.save('BodyMatrix-Master-Catalog.pdf');
      setDoneId('all');
      setTimeout(() => setDoneId(null), 3000);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Master PDF Sync Failure:", err);
    } finally {
      setIsGenerating(null);
    }
  };

  const downloadLessonPDF = async (lesson: LessonCard, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setIsGenerating(lesson.id);
    try {
      const { jsPDF } = await import('https://esm.sh/jspdf');
      const doc = new jsPDF();
      
      await generateLessonPDF(doc, lesson);
      
      doc.save(`BodyMatrix-Protocol-${lesson.id.toUpperCase()}.pdf`);
      setDoneId(lesson.id);
      setTimeout(() => setDoneId(null), 3000);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Protocol PDF Sync Failure:", err);
    } finally {
      setIsGenerating(null);
    }
  };

  const handleShare = (e: React.MouseEvent, lesson: LessonCard) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setSharingLesson(lesson);
  };

  return (
    <section className="pt-40 pb-32 min-h-screen">
      <div className="container mx-auto px-6">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-6 mb-12">
          <button onClick={onBack} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-neon hover:text-white transition-colors font-orbitron text-xs uppercase tracking-widest">
            <ArrowLeft size={16} /> Back to Hub
          </button>
          
          <button 
            onClick={downloadAllPDF} 
            disabled={!!isGenerating} 
            className="flex items-center gap-3 bg-neon/10 border border-neon/30 text-neon px-8 py-4 rounded-2xl font-orbitron text-[10px] tracking-widest hover:bg-neon hover:text-black transition-all disabled:opacity-50 shadow-neon group"
          >
            {isGenerating === 'all' ? <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" /> : doneId === 'all' ? <Check size={16} /> : <Download size={16} />} 
            DOWNLOAD MASTER CATALOG (PDF)
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="mb-20">
          <span className="text-neon font-space uppercase tracking-[0.4em] text-xs font-bold mb-4 block">Knowledge Extraction</span>
          <h1 className="font-orbitron text-4xl md:text-6xl font-bold text-white mb-6 uppercase leading-tight text-glow">PROTOCOL REPOSITORY</h1>
          <p className="font-space text-gray-400 max-w-2xl text-lg leading-relaxed">
            25 high-performance training protocols designed for the modern architect. Optimized for maximum biological output.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="grid md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8">
          {allLessons.map((lesson) => (
            <div key={lesson.id} onClick={() => onSelectLesson(lesson)} className="group relative bg-dark-lighter border border-white/5 hover:border-neon transition-all duration-500 rounded-3xl overflow-hidden shadow-lg cursor-pointer flex flex-col h-full">
              <div className="h-60 overflow-hidden relative shrink-0">
                <img src={lesson.image} alt={lesson.title} className="w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-700 group-hover:scale-110 opacity-60 group-hover:opacity-100" />
                <div className="absolute top-6 left-6 bg-black/80 border border-neon/30 px-3 py-1 text-[10px] text-neon font-orbitron uppercase tracking-widest">{lesson.tag}</div>
                
                <div className="absolute top-6 right-6 flex gap-2">
                  <button 
                    onClick={(e) => downloadLessonPDF(lesson, e)}
                    className="p-3 bg-black/60 border border-white/10 text-white rounded-full hover:bg-neon hover:text-black hover:border-neon transition-all z-20 flex items-center justify-center"
                    title="Download Protocol PDF"
                  >
                    {isGenerating === lesson.id ? <Loader2 size={18} className="animate-spin" /> : doneId === lesson.id ? <Check size={18} /> : <FileText size={18} />}
                  </button>
                  <button onClick={(e) => handleShare(e, lesson)} className="p-3 bg-black/60 border border-white/10 text-white rounded-full hover:bg-neon hover:text-black hover:border-neon transition-all z-20" title="Share Topic">
                    <Share2 size={18} />
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/20 flex items-center justify-center opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
                  <div className="bg-neon rounded-full p-4 text-black shadow-neon"><Play fill="currentColor" size={24} /></div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="p-8 flex flex-col flex-grow">
                <h3 className="font-orbitron text-lg font-bold text-white mb-4 leading-tight group-hover:text-neon transition-colors uppercase">{lesson.title}</h3>
                <p className="font-space text-gray-400 mb-8 leading-relaxed line-clamp-2 text-sm">{lesson.description}</p>
                <div className="mt-auto flex justify-between items-center"><span className="font-orbitron text-[9px] text-neon/40 tracking-[0.2em] uppercase">Ready for Sync</span>
                  <button className="text-neon border border-neon/30 px-6 py-2 rounded-full font-orbitron text-[10px] hover:bg-neon hover:text-black transition-all">OPEN PROTOCOL</button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
      {sharingLesson && <ShareModal isOpen={!!sharingLesson} onClose={() => setSharingLesson(null)} title={sharingLesson.title} url={window.location.origin + "/#lesson/" + sharingLesson.id} />}
    </section>
  );
};

export default FreeLessons;

const FreeLessons: React.FC<FreeLessonsProps> = ({ onBack, onSelectLesson }) => {
  const [isGenerating, setIsGenerating] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [sharingLesson, setSharingLesson] = useState<LessonCard | null>(null);
  const [doneId, setDoneId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // BodyMatrix Brand Colors
  const neonLime = [163, 255, 18]; // #A3FF12
  const darkBg = [11, 15, 12];     // #0B0F0C
  const darkLighter = [18, 24, 20]; // #121814
  
  const margin = 20;
  const contentWidth = 170;
  const pageHeightLimit = 265;

  const applyBrandStyles = (doc: any, lesson: LessonCard) => {
    // Page background
    doc.setFillColor(darkBg[0], darkBg[1], darkBg[2]);
    doc.rect(0, 0, 210, 297, 'F');

    // Header Glow
    doc.setFillColor(neonLime[0], neonLime[1], neonLime[2], 0.05);
    doc.rect(0, 0, 210, 40, 'F');
    
    // Header Info
    doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
    doc.setFontSize(7);
    doc.setTextColor(neonLime[0], neonLime[1], neonLime[2]);
    doc.text(`BODYMATRIX.AI // PROTOCOL ID: ${lesson.id.toUpperCase()}`, margin, 15);
    doc.text(`SYNC STATUS: VALIDATED`, 190, 15, { align: 'right' });

    // Footer Info
    const pageHeight = doc.internal.pageSize.height;
    doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
    doc.setFontSize(6);
    doc.setTextColor(80, 80, 80);
    doc.text(`@BODYMATRIX.AI • PART OF SAYEMATRIX ECOSYSTEM • PAGE ${doc.internal.getNumberOfPages()}`, margin, pageHeight - 12);
    doc.text(`"FREEDOM THROUGH STRUCTURE"`, 190, pageHeight - 12, { align: 'right' });
  };

  const generateLessonPDF = async (doc: any, lesson: LessonCard, startWithCover: boolean = false) => {
    let currentY = 35;

    if (startWithCover) {
      // BRAND COVER PAGE
      doc.setFillColor(darkBg[0], darkBg[1], darkBg[2]);
      doc.rect(0, 0, 210, 297, 'F');
      
      // Decorative elements
      doc.setDrawColor(neonLime[0], neonLime[1], neonLime[2]);
      doc.setLineWidth(0.5);
      doc.line(20, 130, 80, 130);

      doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
      doc.setFontSize(44);
      doc.setTextColor(neonLime[0], neonLime[1], neonLime[2]);
      doc.text("BODYMATRIX.AI", 20, 100);
      
      doc.setFontSize(16);
      doc.setTextColor(255, 255, 255);
      doc.text("KNOWLEDGEBASE CATALOG", 20, 115);
      
      doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
      doc.setFontSize(10);
      doc.setTextColor(150, 150, 150);
      doc.text("25 HIGH-PERFORMANCE MOVEMENT PROTOCOLS", 20, 125);
      doc.text("ENGINEERED FOR BIOLOGICAL SOVEREIGNTY", 20, 140);
      
      doc.setFontSize(8);
      doc.setTextColor(80, 80, 80);
      doc.text("SAYEMATRIX FREE LEARNING SYSTEM // VERSION 3.0", 20, 275);
      
      doc.addPage();
    }

    applyBrandStyles(doc, lesson);

    // Protocol Category Tag
    doc.setFillColor(neonLime[0], neonLime[1], neonLime[2]);
    doc.rect(margin, currentY, 25, 6, 'F');
    doc.setFontSize(7);
    doc.setTextColor(0, 0, 0);
    doc.text(lesson.tag.toUpperCase(), margin + 2, currentY + 4.5);
    currentY += 15;

    // Lesson Title
    doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
    doc.setFontSize(26);
    doc.setTextColor(255, 255, 255);
    const titleLines = doc.splitTextToSize(lesson.title.toUpperCase(), contentWidth);
    doc.text(titleLines, margin, currentY);
    currentY += (titleLines.length * 11) + 12;

    // Full Content Body
    doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
    doc.setFontSize(11);
    doc.setTextColor(200, 200, 200);
    const contentLines = doc.splitTextToSize(lesson.content, contentWidth);
    
    contentLines.forEach((line: string) => {
      if (currentY > pageHeightLimit) {
        doc.addPage();
        applyBrandStyles(doc, lesson);
        currentY = 35;
        doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
        doc.setFontSize(11);
        doc.setTextColor(200, 200, 200);
      }
      doc.text(line, margin, currentY, { align: 'justify', lineHeightFactor: 1.5 });
      currentY += 6.5;
    });

    currentY += 15;

    // Break Line
    doc.setDrawColor(30, 30, 30);
    doc.setLineWidth(0.5);
    doc.line(margin, currentY, margin + contentWidth, currentY);
    currentY += 12;

    // Boxed Technical Sections
    const drawTechnicalBox = (title: string, items: string | string[]) => {
      doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
      doc.setFontSize(10);
      doc.setTextColor(neonLime[0], neonLime[1], neonLime[2]);
      
      const lines = Array.isArray(items) 
        ? items.flatMap(item => doc.splitTextToSize(`• ${item}`, contentWidth - 14))
        : doc.splitTextToSize(items, contentWidth - 14);
      
      const boxHeight = (lines.length * 6) + 16;

      if (currentY + boxHeight > pageHeightLimit) {
        doc.addPage();
        applyBrandStyles(doc, lesson);
        currentY = 35;
        doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
        doc.setFontSize(10);
        doc.setTextColor(neonLime[0], neonLime[1], neonLime[2]);
      }

      // Box Background
      doc.setFillColor(darkLighter[0], darkLighter[1], darkLighter[2]);
      doc.setDrawColor(neonLime[0], neonLime[1], neonLime[2], 0.3);
      doc.rect(margin, currentY, contentWidth, boxHeight, 'FD');

      // Title
      doc.text(title.toUpperCase(), margin + 7, currentY + 8);
      
      // Text
      doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
      doc.setFontSize(10);
      doc.setTextColor(240, 240, 240);
      lines.forEach((line: string, i: number) => {
        doc.text(line, margin + 7, currentY + 16 + (i * 6));
      });
      
      currentY += boxHeight + 10;
    };

    if (lesson.objective) drawTechnicalBox("Operational Objective", lesson.objective);
    if (lesson.principles) drawTechnicalBox("Core Biomechanical Principles", lesson.principles);
    if (lesson.actionSteps) drawTechnicalBox("Systemic Action Breakdown", lesson.actionSteps);
  };

  const downloadAllPDF = async () => {
    setIsGenerating('all');
    try {
      const { jsPDF } = await import('https://esm.sh/jspdf');
      const doc = new jsPDF();
      
      for (let i = 0; i < allLessons.length; i++) {
        await generateLessonPDF(doc, allLessons[i], i === 0);
        if (i < allLessons.length - 1) {
          doc.addPage();
        }
      }

      doc.save('BodyMatrix-Master-Catalog.pdf');
      setDoneId('all');
      setTimeout(() => setDoneId(null), 3000);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Master PDF Sync Failure:", err);
    } finally {
      setIsGenerating(null);
    }
  };

  const downloadLessonPDF = async (lesson: LessonCard, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setIsGenerating(lesson.id);
    try {
      const { jsPDF } = await import('https://esm.sh/jspdf');
      const doc = new jsPDF();
      
      await generateLessonPDF(doc, lesson);
      
      doc.save(`BodyMatrix-Protocol-${lesson.id.toUpperCase()}.pdf`);
      setDoneId(lesson.id);
      setTimeout(() => setDoneId(null), 3000);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Protocol PDF Sync Failure:", err);
    } finally {
      setIsGenerating(null);
    }
  };

  const handleShare = (e: React.MouseEvent, lesson: LessonCard) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setSharingLesson(lesson);
  };

  return (
    <section className="pt-40 pb-32 min-h-screen">
      <div className="container mx-auto px-6">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-6 mb-12">
          <button onClick={onBack} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-neon hover:text-white transition-colors font-orbitron text-xs uppercase tracking-widest">
            <ArrowLeft size={16} /> Back to Hub
          </button>
          
          <button 
            onClick={downloadAllPDF} 
            disabled={!!isGenerating} 
            className="flex items-center gap-3 bg-neon/10 border border-neon/30 text-neon px-8 py-4 rounded-2xl font-orbitron text-[10px] tracking-widest hover:bg-neon hover:text-black transition-all disabled:opacity-50 shadow-neon group"
          >
            {isGenerating === 'all' ? <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" /> : doneId === 'all' ? <Check size={16} /> : <Download size={16} />} 
            DOWNLOAD MASTER CATALOG (PDF)
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="mb-20">
          <span className="text-neon font-space uppercase tracking-[0.4em] text-xs font-bold mb-4 block">Knowledge Extraction</span>
          <h1 className="font-orbitron text-4xl md:text-6xl font-bold text-white mb-6 uppercase leading-tight text-glow">PROTOCOL REPOSITORY</h1>
          <p className="font-space text-gray-400 max-w-2xl text-lg leading-relaxed">
            25 high-performance training protocols designed for the modern architect. Optimized for maximum biological output.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="grid md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8">
          {allLessons.map((lesson) => (
            <div key={lesson.id} onClick={() => onSelectLesson(lesson)} className="group relative bg-dark-lighter border border-white/5 hover:border-neon transition-all duration-500 rounded-3xl overflow-hidden shadow-lg cursor-pointer flex flex-col h-full">
              <div className="h-60 overflow-hidden relative shrink-0">
                <SafeImage src={lesson.image} alt={lesson.title} className="w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-700 group-hover:scale-110 opacity-80 group-hover:opacity-100" />
                <div className="absolute top-6 left-6 bg-black/80 border border-neon/30 px-3 py-1 text-[10px] text-neon font-orbitron uppercase tracking-widest">{lesson.tag}</div>
                
                <div className="absolute top-6 right-6 flex gap-2">
                  <button 
                    onClick={(e) => downloadLessonPDF(lesson, e)}
                    className="p-3 bg-black/60 border border-white/10 text-white rounded-full hover:bg-neon hover:text-black hover:border-neon transition-all z-20 flex items-center justify-center"
                    title="Download Protocol PDF"
                  >
                    {isGenerating === lesson.id ? <Loader2 size={18} className="animate-spin" /> : doneId === lesson.id ? <Check size={18} /> : <FileText size={18} />}
                  </button>
                  <button onClick={(e) => handleShare(e, lesson)} className="p-3 bg-black/60 border border-white/10 text-white rounded-full hover:bg-neon hover:text-black hover:border-neon transition-all z-20" title="Share Topic">
                    <Share2 size={18} />
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/20 flex items-center justify-center opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
                  <div className="bg-neon rounded-full p-4 text-black shadow-neon"><Play fill="currentColor" size={24} /></div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="p-8 flex flex-col flex-grow">
                <h3 className="font-orbitron text-lg font-bold text-white mb-4 leading-tight group-hover:text-neon transition-colors uppercase">{lesson.title}</h3>
                <p className="font-space text-gray-400 mb-8 leading-relaxed line-clamp-2 text-sm">{lesson.description}</p>
                <div className="mt-auto flex justify-between items-center"><span className="font-orbitron text-[9px] text-neon/40 tracking-[0.2em] uppercase">Ready for Sync</span>
                  <button className="text-neon border border-neon/30 px-6 py-2 rounded-full font-orbitron text-[10px] hover:bg-neon hover:text-black transition-all">OPEN PROTOCOL</button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
      {sharingLesson && <ShareModal isOpen={!!sharingLesson} onClose={() => setSharingLesson(null)} title={sharingLesson.title} url={window.location.origin + "/#lesson/" + sharingLesson.id} />}
    </section>
  );
};

export default FreeLessons;

const SafeImage = ({ src, alt, className }: { src: string, alt: string, className: string }) => {
  const [imgSrc, setImgSrc] = useState(src);
  return (
    <img 
      src={imgSrc} 
      alt={alt} 
      className={className} 
      onError={() => setImgSrc(FALLBACK_IMAGE)}
      loading="lazy"
    />
  );
};

const FreeLessons: React.FC<FreeLessonsProps> = ({ onBack, onSelectLesson }) => {
  const [isGenerating, setIsGenerating] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [sharingLesson, setSharingLesson] = useState<LessonCard | null>(null);
  const [doneId, setDoneId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const neonLime = [163, 255, 18];
  const darkBg = [11, 15, 12];
  const darkLighter = [18, 24, 20];
  
  const margin = 20;
  const contentWidth = 170;
  const pageHeightLimit = 265;

  const applyBrandStyles = (doc: any, lesson: LessonCard) => {
    doc.setFillColor(darkBg[0], darkBg[1], darkBg[2]);
    doc.rect(0, 0, 210, 297, 'F');
    doc.setFillColor(neonLime[0], neonLime[1], neonLime[2], 0.05);
    doc.rect(0, 0, 210, 40, 'F');
    doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
    doc.setFontSize(7);
    doc.setTextColor(neonLime[0], neonLime[1], neonLime[2]);
    doc.text(`BODYMATRIX.AI // PROTOCOL ID: ${lesson.id.toUpperCase()}`, margin, 15);
    doc.text(`SYNC STATUS: VALIDATED`, 190, 15, { align: 'right' });
    const pageHeight = doc.internal.pageSize.height;
    doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
    doc.setFontSize(6);
    doc.setTextColor(80, 80, 80);
    doc.text(`@BODYMATRIX.AI • PART OF SAYEMATRIX ECOSYSTEM • PAGE ${doc.internal.getNumberOfPages()}`, margin, pageHeight - 12);
    doc.text(`"FREEDOM THROUGH STRUCTURE"`, 190, pageHeight - 12, { align: 'right' });
  };

  const generateLessonPDF = async (doc: any, lesson: LessonCard, startWithCover: boolean = false) => {
    let currentY = 35;
    if (startWithCover) {
      doc.setFillColor(darkBg[0], darkBg[1], darkBg[2]);
      doc.rect(0, 0, 210, 297, 'F');
      doc.setDrawColor(neonLime[0], neonLime[1], neonLime[2]);
      doc.setLineWidth(0.5);
      doc.line(20, 130, 80, 130);
      doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
      doc.setFontSize(44);
      doc.setTextColor(neonLime[0], neonLime[1], neonLime[2]);
      doc.text("BODYMATRIX.AI", 20, 100);
      doc.setFontSize(16);
      doc.setTextColor(255, 255, 255);
      doc.text("KNOWLEDGEBASE CATALOG", 20, 115);
      doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
      doc.setFontSize(10);
      doc.setTextColor(150, 150, 150);
      doc.text("25 HIGH-PERFORMANCE MOVEMENT PROTOCOLS", 20, 125);
      doc.text("ENGINEERED FOR BIOLOGICAL SOVEREIGNTY", 20, 140);
      doc.setFontSize(8);
      doc.setTextColor(80, 80, 80);
      doc.text("SAYEMATRIX FREE LEARNING SYSTEM // VERSION 3.0", 20, 275);
      doc.addPage();
    }
    applyBrandStyles(doc, lesson);
    doc.setFillColor(neonLime[0], neonLime[1], neonLime[2]);
    doc.rect(margin, currentY, 25, 6, 'F');
    doc.setFontSize(7);
    doc.setTextColor(0, 0, 0);
    doc.text(lesson.tag.toUpperCase(), margin + 2, currentY + 4.5);
    currentY += 15;
    doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
    doc.setFontSize(26);
    doc.setTextColor(255, 255, 255);
    const titleLines = doc.splitTextToSize(lesson.title.toUpperCase(), contentWidth);
    doc.text(titleLines, margin, currentY);
    currentY += (titleLines.length * 11) + 12;
    doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
    doc.setFontSize(11);
    doc.setTextColor(200, 200, 200);
    const contentLines = doc.splitTextToSize(lesson.content, contentWidth);
    contentLines.forEach((line: string) => {
      if (currentY > pageHeightLimit) {
        doc.addPage();
        applyBrandStyles(doc, lesson);
        currentY = 35;
        doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
        doc.setFontSize(11);
        doc.setTextColor(200, 200, 200);
      }
      doc.text(line, margin, currentY, { align: 'justify', lineHeightFactor: 1.5 });
      currentY += 6.5;
    });
    currentY += 15;
    doc.setDrawColor(30, 30, 30);
    doc.setLineWidth(0.5);
    doc.line(margin, currentY, margin + contentWidth, currentY);
    currentY += 12;
    const drawTechnicalBox = (title: string, items: string | string[]) => {
      doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
      doc.setFontSize(10);
      doc.setTextColor(neonLime[0], neonLime[1], neonLime[2]);
      const lines = Array.isArray(items) 
        ? items.flatMap(item => doc.splitTextToSize(`• ${item}`, contentWidth - 14))
        : doc.splitTextToSize(items, contentWidth - 14);
      const boxHeight = (lines.length * 6) + 16;
      if (currentY + boxHeight > pageHeightLimit) {
        doc.addPage();
        applyBrandStyles(doc, lesson);
        currentY = 35;
        doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
        doc.setFontSize(10);
        doc.setTextColor(neonLime[0], neonLime[1], neonLime[2]);
      }
      doc.setFillColor(darkLighter[0], darkLighter[1], darkLighter[2]);
      doc.setDrawColor(neonLime[0], neonLime[1], neonLime[2], 0.3);
      doc.rect(margin, currentY, contentWidth, boxHeight, 'FD');
      doc.text(title.toUpperCase(), margin + 7, currentY + 8);
      doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
      doc.setFontSize(10);
      doc.setTextColor(240, 240, 240);
      lines.forEach((line: string, i: number) => {
        doc.text(line, margin + 7, currentY + 16 + (i * 6));
      });
      currentY += boxHeight + 10;
    };
    if (lesson.objective) drawTechnicalBox("Operational Objective", lesson.objective);
    if (lesson.principles) drawTechnicalBox("Core Biomechanical Principles", lesson.principles);
    if (lesson.actionSteps) drawTechnicalBox("Systemic Action Breakdown", lesson.actionSteps);
  };

  const downloadAllPDF = async () => {
    setIsGenerating('all');
    try {
      const { jsPDF } = await import('https://esm.sh/jspdf');
      const doc = new jsPDF();
      for (let i = 0; i < allLessons.length; i++) {
        await generateLessonPDF(doc, allLessons[i], i === 0);
        if (i < allLessons.length - 1) doc.addPage();
      }
      doc.save('BodyMatrix-Master-Catalog.pdf');
      setDoneId('all');
      setTimeout(() => setDoneId(null), 3000);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Master PDF Sync Failure:", err);
    } finally {
      setIsGenerating(null);
    }
  };

  const downloadLessonPDF = async (lesson: LessonCard, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setIsGenerating(lesson.id);
    try {
      const { jsPDF } = await import('https://esm.sh/jspdf');
      const doc = new jsPDF();
      await generateLessonPDF(doc, lesson);
      doc.save(`BodyMatrix-Protocol-${lesson.id.toUpperCase()}.pdf`);
      setDoneId(lesson.id);
      setTimeout(() => setDoneId(null), 3000);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Protocol PDF Sync Failure:", err);
    } finally {
      setIsGenerating(null);
    }
  };

  const handleShare = (e: React.MouseEvent, lesson: LessonCard) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setSharingLesson(lesson);
  };

  return (
    <section className="pt-32 md:pt-40 pb-16 md:pb-32 min-h-screen">
      <div className="container mx-auto px-6">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-6 mb-12">
          <button onClick={onBack} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-neon hover:text-white transition-colors font-orbitron text-[10px] md:text-xs uppercase tracking-widest">
            <ArrowLeft size={16} /> Back to Hub
          </button>
          
          <button 
            onClick={downloadAllPDF} 
            disabled={!!isGenerating} 
            className="w-full sm:w-auto flex items-center justify-center gap-3 bg-neon/10 border border-neon/30 text-neon px-6 md:px-8 py-4 rounded-2xl font-orbitron text-[9px] md:text-[10px] tracking-widest hover:bg-neon hover:text-black transition-all disabled:opacity-50 shadow-neon"
          >
            {isGenerating === 'all' ? <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" /> : doneId === 'all' ? <Check size={16} /> : <Download size={16} />} 
            DOWNLOAD MASTER CATALOG
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="mb-12 md:mb-20 text-center sm:text-left">
          <span className="text-neon font-space uppercase tracking-[0.4em] text-[10px] md:text-xs font-bold mb-4 block">Knowledge Extraction</span>
          <h1 className="font-orbitron text-3xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold text-white mb-6 uppercase leading-tight text-glow">PROTOCOL REPOSITORY</h1>
          <p className="font-space text-gray-400 max-w-2xl text-base md:text-lg leading-relaxed">
            25 high-performance training protocols designed for the modern architect. Optimized for maximum biological output.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 md:gap-8">
          {allLessons.map((lesson) => (
            <div key={lesson.id} onClick={() => onSelectLesson(lesson)} className="group relative bg-dark-lighter border border-white/5 hover:border-neon transition-all duration-500 rounded-2xl md:rounded-3xl overflow-hidden shadow-lg cursor-pointer flex flex-col h-full">
              <div className="h-48 md:h-60 overflow-hidden relative shrink-0">
                <SafeImage src={lesson.image} alt={lesson.title} className="w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-700 group-hover:scale-110 opacity-70 group-hover:opacity-100" />
                <div className="absolute top-4 md:top-6 left-4 md:left-6 bg-black/80 border border-neon/30 px-2 md:px-3 py-1 text-[9px] md:text-[10px] text-neon font-orbitron uppercase tracking-widest">{lesson.tag}</div>
                
                <div className="absolute top-4 md:top-6 right-4 md:top-6 flex gap-2">
                  <button onClick={(e) => downloadLessonPDF(lesson, e)} className="p-2 md:p-3 bg-black/60 border border-white/10 text-white rounded-full hover:bg-neon hover:text-black hover:border-neon transition-all z-20 flex items-center justify-center">
                    {isGenerating === lesson.id ? <Loader2 size={16} md:size={18} className="animate-spin" /> : doneId === lesson.id ? <Check size={16} md:size={18} /> : <FileText size={16} md:size={18} />}
                  </button>
                  <button onClick={(e) => handleShare(e, lesson)} className="p-2 md:p-3 bg-black/60 border border-white/10 text-white rounded-full hover:bg-neon hover:text-black hover:border-neon transition-all z-20">
                    <Share2 size={16} md:size={18} />
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/20 flex items-center justify-center opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
                  <div className="bg-neon rounded-full p-3 md:p-4 text-black shadow-neon"><Play fill="currentColor" size={20} md:size={24} /></div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="p-6 md:p-8 flex flex-col flex-grow">
                <h3 className="font-orbitron text-base md:text-lg font-bold text-white mb-3 md:mb-4 leading-tight group-hover:text-neon transition-colors uppercase">{lesson.title}</h3>
                <p className="font-space text-gray-400 mb-6 md:mb-8 leading-relaxed line-clamp-2 text-xs md:text-sm">{lesson.description}</p>
                <div className="mt-auto flex justify-between items-center">
                  <span className="font-orbitron text-[8px] md:text-[9px] text-neon/40 tracking-[0.2em] uppercase">Sync Ready</span>
                  <button className="text-neon border border-neon/30 px-4 md:px-6 py-1.5 md:py-2 rounded-full font-orbitron text-[9px] md:text-[10px] hover:bg-neon hover:text-black transition-all">OPEN PROTOCOL</button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
      {sharingLesson && <ShareModal isOpen={!!sharingLesson} onClose={() => setSharingLesson(null)} title={sharingLesson.title} url={window.location.origin + "/#lesson/" + sharingLesson.id} />}
    </section>
  );
};

export default FreeLessons;

**Addressing Icon Size Errors**

I'm working on the Lucide icon size issue. I realize that the `md:size` prop is incorrect; Lucide doesn't handle responsive props. My task now is removing it from the relevant components to resolve the errors. This seems straightforward.


**Refining Sizing Logic**

I'm now implementing the fixes for the invalid `md:size` props. I've begun adjusting the icon components, replacing instances of `md:size` with either the base `size` prop or Tailwind CSS classes for responsive adjustments. For example, in `Tools.tsx`, I've changed the `<X>` component to utilize Tailwind classes and removed `md:size`. I've also checked `DiscordIcon`, and can confirm it correctly uses the base `size` prop. I'm proceeding file by file.


**Eliminating More Size Errors**

I'm removing more invalid `md:size` props. Specifically, I've addressed multiple instances in `LessonCard.tsx`, removing `md:size` from `Loader2`, `Check`, `FileText`, `Share2`, and `Play`. I've also tackled the `PhilosophySection.tsx` file, removing the problematic prop from `ShieldCheck` and `ArrowRight`. Now, I'm thinking, removing it might cause a minor UI shift on medium screens. My focus is still removing the non-existent property type error. The core problem is that Lucide doesn't support responsive sizes directly, so Tailwind is the way to solve responsive styling.


**Refining Tailwind Integration**

I'm now integrating Tailwind classes to handle responsive sizing in lieu of the incorrect `md:size` prop. I'm focusing on ensuring visual consistency after the fixes. For example, I've modified the `<X>` component in `Tools.tsx` to use Tailwind's `md:w-8 md:h-8` for medium screens, while other icons are changed to size 16 with custom size in md. The goal is to address the type errors by replacing the invalid prop, while carefully considering the overall UI impact.


**Implementing Tailwind Classes**

I'm now implementing the latest updates from code review. I'm focusing on `components/Tools.tsx` and `components/Community.tsx`, specifically replacing `md:size` props with Tailwind classes. For instance, I've updated the `<X>` icon in `Tools.tsx` to use `md:w-8 md:h-8` and other icons to be sized correctly. Also, I've modified `DiscordIcon` in `Community.tsx` to accept a `className` prop for Tailwind integration, resolving size issues and enabling conditional styling.


**Removing Invalid Props**

I'm now focusing on removing the invalid `md:size` props as the simplest fix, as I've found that Lucide icons don't support responsive sizes. I've removed `md:size` from `Loader2`, `Check`, `FileText`, `Share2`, and `Play` in `components/FreeLessons.tsx`. Additionally, I removed `md:size` from `ShieldCheck` and `ArrowRight` in `components/PhilosophySection.tsx`. No, I'll go through the error logs.

const SafeImage = ({ src, alt, className }: { src: string, alt: string, className: string }) => {
  const [imgSrc, setImgSrc] = useState(src);
  return (
    <img 
      src={imgSrc} 
      alt={alt} 
      className={className} 
      onError={() => setImgSrc(FALLBACK_IMAGE)}
      loading="lazy"
    />
  );
};

const FreeLessons: React.FC<FreeLessonsProps> = ({ onBack, onSelectLesson }) => {
  const [isGenerating, setIsGenerating] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [sharingLesson, setSharingLesson] = useState<LessonCard | null>(null);
  const [doneId, setDoneId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const neonLime = [163, 255, 18];
  const darkBg = [11, 15, 12];
  const darkLighter = [18, 24, 20];
  
  const margin = 20;
  const contentWidth = 170;
  const pageHeightLimit = 265;

  const applyBrandStyles = (doc: any, lesson: LessonCard) => {
    doc.setFillColor(darkBg[0], darkBg[1], darkBg[2]);
    doc.rect(0, 0, 210, 297, 'F');
    doc.setFillColor(neonLime[0], neonLime[1], neonLime[2], 0.05);
    doc.rect(0, 0, 210, 40, 'F');
    doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
    doc.setFontSize(7);
    doc.setTextColor(neonLime[0], neonLime[1], neonLime[2]);
    doc.text(`BODYMATRIX.AI // PROTOCOL ID: ${lesson.id.toUpperCase()}`, margin, 15);
    doc.text(`SYNC STATUS: VALIDATED`, 190, 15, { align: 'right' });
    const pageHeight = doc.internal.pageSize.height;
    doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
    doc.setFontSize(6);
    doc.setTextColor(80, 80, 80);
    doc.text(`@BODYMATRIX.AI • PART OF SAYEMATRIX ECOSYSTEM • PAGE ${doc.internal.getNumberOfPages()}`, margin, pageHeight - 12);
    doc.text(`"FREEDOM THROUGH STRUCTURE"`, 190, pageHeight - 12, { align: 'right' });
  };

  const generateLessonPDF = async (doc: any, lesson: LessonCard, startWithCover: boolean = false) => {
    let currentY = 35;
    if (startWithCover) {
      doc.setFillColor(darkBg[0], darkBg[1], darkBg[2]);
      doc.rect(0, 0, 210, 297, 'F');
      doc.setDrawColor(neonLime[0], neonLime[1], neonLime[2]);
      doc.setLineWidth(0.5);
      doc.line(20, 130, 80, 130);
      doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
      doc.setFontSize(44);
      doc.setTextColor(neonLime[0], neonLime[1], neonLime[2]);
      doc.text("BODYMATRIX.AI", 20, 100);
      doc.setFontSize(16);
      doc.setTextColor(255, 255, 255);
      doc.text("KNOWLEDGEBASE CATALOG", 20, 115);
      doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
      doc.setFontSize(10);
      doc.setTextColor(150, 150, 150);
      doc.text("25 HIGH-PERFORMANCE MOVEMENT PROTOCOLS", 20, 125);
      doc.text("ENGINEERED FOR BIOLOGICAL SOVEREIGNTY", 20, 140);
      doc.setFontSize(8);
      doc.setTextColor(80, 80, 80);
      doc.text("SAYEMATRIX FREE LEARNING SYSTEM // VERSION 3.0", 20, 275);
      doc.addPage();
    }
    applyBrandStyles(doc, lesson);
    doc.setFillColor(neonLime[0], neonLime[1], neonLime[2]);
    doc.rect(margin, currentY, 25, 6, 'F');
    doc.setFontSize(7);
    doc.setTextColor(0, 0, 0);
    doc.text(lesson.tag.toUpperCase(), margin + 2, currentY + 4.5);
    currentY += 15;
    doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
    doc.setFontSize(26);
    doc.setTextColor(255, 255, 255);
    const titleLines = doc.splitTextToSize(lesson.title.toUpperCase(), contentWidth);
    doc.text(titleLines, margin, currentY);
    currentY += (titleLines.length * 11) + 12;
    doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
    doc.setFontSize(11);
    doc.setTextColor(200, 200, 200);
    const contentLines = doc.splitTextToSize(lesson.content, contentWidth);
    contentLines.forEach((line: string) => {
      if (currentY > pageHeightLimit) {
        doc.addPage();
        applyBrandStyles(doc, lesson);
        currentY = 35;
        doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
        doc.setFontSize(11);
        doc.setTextColor(200, 200, 200);
      }
      doc.text(line, margin, currentY, { align: 'justify', lineHeightFactor: 1.5 });
      currentY += 6.5;
    });
    currentY += 15;
    doc.setDrawColor(30, 30, 30);
    doc.setLineWidth(0.5);
    doc.line(margin, currentY, margin + contentWidth, currentY);
    currentY += 12;
    const drawTechnicalBox = (title: string, items: string | string[]) => {
      doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
      doc.setFontSize(10);
      doc.setTextColor(neonLime[0], neonLime[1], neonLime[2]);
      const lines = Array.isArray(items) 
        ? items.flatMap(item => doc.splitTextToSize(`• ${item}`, contentWidth - 14))
        : doc.splitTextToSize(items, contentWidth - 14);
      const boxHeight = (lines.length * 6) + 16;
      if (currentY + boxHeight > pageHeightLimit) {
        doc.addPage();
        applyBrandStyles(doc, lesson);
        currentY = 35;
        doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
        doc.setFontSize(10);
        doc.setTextColor(neonLime[0], neonLime[1], neonLime[2]);
      }
      doc.setFillColor(darkLighter[0], darkLighter[1], darkLighter[2]);
      doc.setDrawColor(neonLime[0], neonLime[1], neonLime[2], 0.3);
      doc.rect(margin, currentY, contentWidth, boxHeight, 'FD');
      doc.text(title.toUpperCase(), margin + 7, currentY + 8);
      doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
      doc.setFontSize(10);
      doc.setTextColor(240, 240, 240);
      lines.forEach((line: string, i: number) => {
        doc.text(line, margin + 7, currentY + 16 + (i * 6));
      });
      currentY += boxHeight + 10;
    };
    if (lesson.objective) drawTechnicalBox("Operational Objective", lesson.objective);
    if (lesson.principles) drawTechnicalBox("Core Biomechanical Principles", lesson.principles);
    if (lesson.actionSteps) drawTechnicalBox("Systemic Action Breakdown", lesson.actionSteps);
  };

  const downloadAllPDF = async () => {
    setIsGenerating('all');
    try {
      const { jsPDF } = await import('https://esm.sh/jspdf');
      const doc = new jsPDF();
      for (let i = 0; i < allLessons.length; i++) {
        await generateLessonPDF(doc, allLessons[i], i === 0);
        if (i < allLessons.length - 1) doc.addPage();
      }
      doc.save('BodyMatrix-Master-Catalog.pdf');
      setDoneId('all');
      setTimeout(() => setDoneId(null), 3000);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Master PDF Sync Failure:", err);
    } finally {
      setIsGenerating(null);
    }
  };

  const downloadLessonPDF = async (lesson: LessonCard, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setIsGenerating(lesson.id);
    try {
      const { jsPDF } = await import('https://esm.sh/jspdf');
      const doc = new jsPDF();
      await generateLessonPDF(doc, lesson);
      doc.save(`BodyMatrix-Protocol-${lesson.id.toUpperCase()}.pdf`);
      setDoneId(lesson.id);
      setTimeout(() => setDoneId(null), 3000);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Protocol PDF Sync Failure:", err);
    } finally {
      setIsGenerating(null);
    }
  };

  const handleShare = (e: React.MouseEvent, lesson: LessonCard) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setSharingLesson(lesson);
  };

  return (
    <section className="pt-32 md:pt-40 pb-16 md:pb-32 min-h-screen">
      <div className="container mx-auto px-6">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-6 mb-12">
          <button onClick={onBack} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-neon hover:text-white transition-colors font-orbitron text-[10px] md:text-xs uppercase tracking-widest">
            <ArrowLeft size={16} /> Back to Hub
          </button>
          
          <button 
            onClick={downloadAllPDF} 
            disabled={!!isGenerating} 
            className="w-full sm:w-auto flex items-center justify-center gap-3 bg-neon/10 border border-neon/30 text-neon px-6 md:px-8 py-4 rounded-2xl font-orbitron text-[9px] md:text-[10px] tracking-widest hover:bg-neon hover:text-black transition-all disabled:opacity-50 shadow-neon"
          >
            {isGenerating === 'all' ? <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" /> : doneId === 'all' ? <Check size={16} /> : <Download size={16} />} 
            DOWNLOAD MASTER CATALOG
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="mb-12 md:mb-20 text-center sm:text-left">
          <span className="text-neon font-space uppercase tracking-[0.4em] text-[10px] md:text-xs font-bold mb-4 block">Knowledge Extraction</span>
